# Ventari contract fixtures (synthetic)

Hand-authored from the TypeScript contract in `ventari-shopware`
`server/utils/ventariCatalogV2.ts` at integration `3ce4c2a`. They contain no
real catalog data and no marketplace imagery (`example.com` URLs only).

They are a placeholder for the recorded, schema-validated fixtures that
VJ-131 produces from a seeded gateway v2 + `CATALOG_MODE=cloudflare` build.
When those exist, replace these files and keep the tests unchanged.
